scenes.event: Evan Butler is caught in a moral conflict while casting his MLB All-Star vote.
scenes.description: Evan sits at his computer late at night, refreshing the MLB All-Star voting page for the fifth time that hour. His wife, Yuna, is nearby reading a book, and their friend Henry calls to check in. Evan is torn between supporting his beloved team and ensuring the voting process remains fair.

characters.name: Evan Butler
characters.description: A 40-year-old baseball enthusiast, married to Yuna. He is thoughtful, analytical, and loyal to his team but also values fairness.; 40-year-old Male, Married, Baseball Enthusiast, 47 years old; Occupation: Office White-collar Worker; Personality: Enthusiastic, Thoughtful, Loyal, Analytical; Values: Fairness, Loyalty, Community, Individuality; Interests: Baseball, Sports Voting, Social Media, Evening Relaxation; Experiences: Watching Baseball Games, Participating in Sports Discussions, Late-night Decision Making, Balancing Personal and Social Expectations, Expressing Opinions Publicly

characters.name: Yuna Butler
characters.description: Calm and empathetic wife who notices her husband's late-night behavior and offers quiet concern; Female; Age: 32; Occupation: Clinical social worker; Personality: Observant, gentle, intuitive; Values: Fairness, family, emotional well-being; Interests: Reading literary fiction, yoga, community activism; Experiences: Worked with at-risk youth in a non-profit setting, navigated ethical dilemmas in her profession, recently supported a friend through a difficult career decision.

characters.name: Henry Ramirez
characters.description: Playful, curious, and unaware; Male; Age: 34; Occupation: High school history teacher and part-time sports commentator for a local radio station; Personality: Laid-back, witty, optimistic; Values: Fairness, loyalty, fun; Interests: Baseball statistics, retro video games, storytelling; Experiences: Coached his son's little league team for five years, covered a minor league championship game as a guest commentator, frequently debates sports with friends over video game simulations.

actions.action: Refreshes the All-Star voting page for the fifth time in an hour.
actions.dialogue: I just don’t know if I should vote for my team again. They’re already way ahead.

actions.action: Looks up from her book and notices Evan’s behavior.
actions.dialogue: You’ve been on that site for hours. Everything okay?

actions.action: Sighs and responds with a mix of honesty and hesitation.
actions.dialogue: It’s just… I feel like I should support them, but it doesn’t feel right when the Yankees are getting so many votes.

actions.action: Calls Evan and teases him about his indecision.
actions.dialogue: Hey, Evan! Still not voting for your team? You’re acting like a neutral commissioner or something.

actions.action: Pauses and thinks before responding to Henry’s comment.
actions.dialogue: I’m just trying to be fair, Henry. I don’t want to feel like I’m skewing the results.

actions.action: Offers a quiet suggestion to help ease the tension.
actions.dialogue: Maybe you can vote for a deserving player from another team this time. You can still support yours in the long run.

actions.action: Laughs and encourages Evan to just go with his gut.
actions.dialogue: Fairness is great, but you’re a fan, not a judge. Just vote for the guys you love to watch.

actions.action: Considers the suggestions and finally makes a decision.
actions.dialogue: You’re both right. I’ll vote for one of the other team’s stars this time. Maybe next year I’ll go all in.

scenes.plot: Evan Butler is torn between his loyalty to his favorite team and his desire to maintain fairness in the All-Star voting process. His wife, Yuna, notices his late-night behavior and gently offers support, while his friend Henry teases him about his unusual hesitation. Through this interaction, Evan comes to a balanced decision that respects both his values and social expectations.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore the tension between personal loyalty and the value of fairness in a public, communal activity like sports voting, while highlighting the supportive yet challenging dynamics in Evan’s relationships.
